jobs.prompt: FINAL test-strength round for T-8011 (coordination/reviews/acc-review-board-accuracy-a3.json). Rewrite the expectations in tests/board-accuracy-activity.test.mjs so EVERY expected value is computed by an oracle that reads the sources on disk after the fixture is built, never from constants the test passed to the fixture: (1) lastRunAt = max startedAt over all .swarm/runs/*/state.json files found under every root listed by `git worktree list --porcelain` run in the main root plus the fixture's scratch roots (read with fs, not with board functions); (2) liveCount and activity (building / active-today / idle) = computed from the registry file (SWARM_PROJECTS_FILE), the live-run records and run state files on disk, and startOfLocalDay; (3) checkouts = number of entries from `git worktree list --porcelain` plus scratch roots that are worktrees of the repo; (4) lastActivityAt and lastTicketFinishedAt = independent max over the run files, ledger updatedAt and tickets.log lines read from disk; (5) finished/deployed: recompute from the ledger file (all counted tickets done), the history file (merge/pr events) and the deploy fixture, then assert the card's finished flag, its 'Finished' label and that live warnings moved to history. Put the oracles in a small helper inside the test file. Change tools/board-data.mjs only if an oracle exposes a real mismatch, and say so. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-accuracy-activity.test.mjs tests/board-accuracy-percent.test.mjs tests/board-*.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
